notes: GAAP city report with governmental activities only (no business-type columns; utilities are not in this report), so business_type is null. Statement lines from the Total Governmental Funds column (p4). ending_cash = cash and cash equivalents + restricted cash + cash at County Treasurer from the governmental funds Balance Sheet Total column (p3). Sale of capital assets is other_financing. Detail: General Fund revenues from its GAAP schedule (p7) and spending from the departmental Schedule of Expenditures (pp8-12; departments total 5,409,188); the General Fund budget-basis schedule (p5) is not recorded to avoid double counting; GF transfers gross from the fund statement (p4) since p7 prints only the net. Special Projects Fund from its budget-basis schedule (p6; budget-basis actuals differ from the GAAP fund statement). Other governmental funds per column from the combining statement (p13). Debt Service Fund has no schedule (not added). Read pages 1-13 of 13
